spanish: Y hizo cortina a la abertura de la tienda, azul y púrpura y grana carmesí y lino retorcido, obra de bordador,
grammarChanges: Translated מָסָךְ (h02036037002), a common noun, as 'cortina' instead of leaving it untranslated as 'masaj'.
Dropped 'fino' from 'lino fino'; lemma 8336 b tagged as cardinal feminine singular leaves the sense open, so 'fino' is an unlicensed addition. Rendered the bare lexeme as 'lino'.
Split the collapsed single word 'carmesí' into two visible terms, 'grana' (h02036037007) and 'carmesí' (h02036037008), so both construct-pair tokens remain present.
